the application of 5% onion juice and 5% green tea extract in Persian sturgeon fillets can significantly retard lipid oxidation and improve sensory characteristics of the fish during refrigerated storage.
2.5 and 5% aqueous solution of onion juice and green tea extract can be used as effective natural antioxidants in Persian sturgeon fillets.
the addition of 5% onion juice and 5% green tea extract to Persian sturgeon fillets can significantly inhibit lipid oxidation and enhance sensory attributes of the fillets.

a novel approach to inhibit lipid oxidation and enhance sensory characteristics of refrigeration-stored sturgeon fillets by using natural antioxidants.
the use of natural antioxidants to improve the shelf life of fish fillets.
the use of natural antioxidants as an alternative to synthetic ones to improve the shelf life of sturgeon fillets.

the addition of 5%OJs and 2.5-5%TEs to Persian sturgeon fillets could be used as a natural and effective way to retard lipid oxidation and improve the sensory characteristics of the product.
5% onion juice and 2.5%-5% green tea extract are recommended for improving lipid stability and sensory characteristics of Persian sturgeon fillets.
the addition of green tea extract and red onion juice to Persian sturgeon fillets is a useful way to reduce lipid oxidation and to enhance sensory characteristics of fillets during cold storage.

the use of 5%Oj or 2.5-5%TE can be recommended for improving the shelf life and sensory attributes of sturgeon fillets.

The main takeaway from our work is that

1) green tea extract and onion juice are effective in retarding the oxidation in Persian sturgeon fillets; 2) the effectiveness of green tea extract was higher than onion juice; 3) 2.5-5% of green tea extract or onion juice could be applied for retarding the oxidation and improving the quality of sturgeon fillets.
